name: rendering-text
description: BitmapFont text rendering with revealable text component and prep/update systems
postInstallNotes:
## rendering-text installed

Text is driven by the `DynamicTextComponent` component (BitmapFont from MonoGame.Extended). For static labels, set `IsRevealed = true` and `VisibleCharacterCount = int.MaxValue` (see `LevelSelectionScreen.cs` for the canonical pattern).

Pipeline order:
- `TextUpdateSystem` (advances reveal state per-frame) BEFORE
- `TextPrepSystem` (writes glyph quads into `DrawComponent`) BEFORE
- `MasterRenderSystem`.

For true typewriter/reveal animation, also install `text-dynamic-reveal` (purely declarative today — same files; documents the reveal usage pattern).

**Premises:** `docs/rendering/premises.md`
